metadata.description: Claude Code mods built on function hooks.

plugins.name: cache-weather
plugins.description: Mod: the prompt cache hit rate as weather, the context window fill as a bar, and the time left on the cache, under the prompt.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Mod by johnnyvizz: a progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel. This copy draws text on the desktop by default.

plugins.name: session-line
plugins.description: Mod: the model, the working directory and the git branch in a row under the prompt.

plugins.name: session-watch
plugins.description: Mod: watches the session and every subagent for stalls, loops, error storms and the context ceiling; quiet under the prompt until something drifts, with a /session-watch sidebar of agents, diagnosis, cache growth and tools.
